IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
wavy dark hair and a red satin bow in
her hair stands by a dark dresser in a
cream room with a daisy vase. She
wears a black lace mini dress with a
flared skirt and red cut-out sleeves
trimmed with white flower appliqués, a
red rose choker, and a red rose brooch.
Red sheer tights and red drop earrings
complete the look. Her expression is
calm, with her gaze looking off to the
side. Soft, warm interior light. Palette of
black, red, and cream. Romantic and
dramatic, in the style of a Valentine's
editorial.
